LOFT PET HOUSE

Care & Grooming Services

Baths, scissor cuts and styled trims. Loving, patient care without anaesthesia.

Our experienced, professional pet grooming team takes care of all your little friends’ care and grooming needs. With scissor cuts, clipper cuts and styled trims, we give your pet the look you want.

For our bathing service, we wash your pets with shampoo suited to their breed, then brush and blow-dry their coats. If your little friend has sensitive skin, we also offer hypoallergenic shampoo options.

** No anaesthesia is used at any stage of our pet grooming service.
